extraction_scope: Worker-6 preserved source-located mechanism context without promoting inferred morphology to a fully resolved mechanism.

mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper frames the carpet model as strongly suggested and says further studies are required to fully elucidate mechanism.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: PvAMP66 plus gentamicin against MDR Klebsiella pneumoniae
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Isobologram/FICI evidence supports an additive interaction with gentamicin and reduced gentamicin effective concentration.

source_locator.primary_source_statement: Figure 2 and section 3.3 report additive interaction and FICI 0.59.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Additive interaction is not synergy; final review preserves this as additive.
